summary: Sandbox variants should scale isolation and capability to task risk rather than exposing one broad environment to every agent.

items.text: Generate a per-task capability manifest and enforce it at filesystem, network, secret and tool boundaries.
Give each task a disposable worktree and export only a reviewed patch plus declared artifacts.
Join model-token, compute-time and external-service ceilings into one enforceable resource budget.
Select local, private-cloud or external sandboxes using the task's provider trust decision and data class.
